Bobby Green is still homeless

Bobby Green’s revelation that he’s homeless, despite owning nine houses, sent shockwaves through the MMA community.

Dana White asked, ‘How is that possible?’ after learning about Green’s current living situation.

The 40-year-old fan favorite has now explained how looking after his nearest and dearest has temporarily left him without a home.

“So about the homeless thing,” Green said during a recent livestream.

“I am homeless, but I’m not houseless. So I can go to anyone’s house. I just don’t have my home.

“I put everybody else before me, just to make sure all my family was taken care of, my friends were taken care of.

“Me, I can go fight and figure it out, but them, it’s gonna be harder for them to figure it out than me.

“I put the weight on my shoulders. I’ll sit around, and I’ll bum it and do whatever we need to do, but everybody else is safe, and everybody else is cool. I’m okay with that.

“So I want to help people, take care of people. That’s it.”

Who is Bobby Green fighting at UFC 332?

Bobby Green enters UFC 332 on a four-fight win streak, which includes three stoppage victories.

Esteban Ribovics is the man who will try to bring Green’s impressive run to an end in Salt Lake City, Utah, on Saturday night.

The 30-year-old has gone 5-4 inside the Octagon since making his company debut in March 2023.

Last time out, Ribovics battered Brazilian legend Edson Barboza into retirement at UFC 330 in August.

Green will be hoping to avoid the same fate when he meets Ribovics at the Delta Center this weekend.
